limitations: All numbers and uncertainty distributions are synthetic and uncalibrated.
Single depot, one unloading server, single aggregate propellant commodity.
No trajectory solver, cryogenic thermal model, mixture ratio or hardware reliability model.
External lead times and delivery-service costs; existing infrastructure and initial stock acquisition outside cost boundary.
Fixed open-loop departures; instantaneous all-or-nothing consumer handover; no downstream transport.
Modeled service frequency is NOT cargo-loss risk, mission reliability or ESA certification.
